title: Noccomack (West Mastic Meadows)
summary: Noccomack is connected with meadows and land on the west side of Mastic Neck in Brookhaven. The recorded forms point to a wetland place between upland and bay on the Mastic Peninsula.
history_content: The placename brings together the Mastic Neck meadow setting, spelling forms, and west-side wetland geography. The overview stays broad while dated source details appear in the historic moments below.
translation_content:
Recorded forms include Nacomak, Nacommock, Necommack, and Noccomack. The name is interpreted as midway place or place between, referring to meadow or marsh ground between the upland and bay.

Why Place Names Matter

“When you sit with the sound of a place, its name spoken aloud, its echoes through chant or song, you may find yourself entering a moment where past, present, and future exist at once.”

— Native Land Digital, Indigenous Place Names (2024), The Story of Place is Alive section
whereintheworld_content: Approximate general point on the west side of Mastic Neck near meadow and marsh land. The map placement is for orientation only, not an exact historic boundary or meadow coordinate. Offset slightly for map visibility near other Mastic Neck placename markers.
